prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_CWT_rf best captures seasonality (0.557), but ONLY_CWT_catboost delivers the lowest overall RMSE (9.751). High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=83.263) and concept drift suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit the additive decomposition structure while adapting to changing patterns.
